name: Saeki Arisa
source:
Hobbies: Taking care of flowers blooming in the garden
Likes: None
Dislikes: Grandfather

A maid at the Saeki residence who is often bullied by [url=/c12952]Mayu[/url]. She always has a disinterested look on her face and she doesn't show much emotion.

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/b-cyc-pro/mdb-dvd2/cha/mdbdvd_cha19.htm]official website[/url].]
